test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states won the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2021 in December at Jaipur?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****Himachal Pradesh **clinched the** Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT) title in 2021-22.**
 
• It was the 20th season of the Vijay Hazare Trophy.
 
• It was the **maiden** Vijay Hazare Trophy title for Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The** runner-up **of the Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT) 2021-22 was** Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The 2021–22 Vijay Hazare Trophy was the 20th season of the Vijay Hazare Trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__** **____**Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT):**__

__
 
• ​It is also known as the** Ranji One-Day Trophy.**
 
• It was started in **2002-03 **as a limited-overs cricket domestic competition involving** state teams from the Ranji Trophy plates.**
 
• It is named after the legendary **Indian cricketer Vijay Hazare.**
 
• From the tournament's inaugural edition in the 1993–94 season to the 2001–02 season, no finals were held, and teams consequently played only within their zones, with no overall winner named.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT) title 2022-23:__

 __
 
• It ​was the **21st season** of the Vijay Hazare Trophy.
 
• **Saurashtra** defeated **Maharashtra **in the final to win their second domestic championship.
 
 
 
• Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT) title 2023-24__
 __
 
• **​__It** ​was the 22nd season of the Vijay Hazare Trophy.
 
• The final was held in Rajkot on December 16, 2023.
 
• **Haryana** emerged as the champions by defeating **Rajasthan**.
